name: pr-flow
description: Skills and a Bash/gh/jq helper for opening a finished pull request ready for review, waiting for checks, addressing reviews and landing changes.

interface.longDescription: Open a finished pull request ready for review, wait until CI and reviewer bots finish, fix or answer every finding, and merge only when the digest is clean. A draft is only for work still in progress. Includes the landing-prs and pr skills plus pr-wait.sh.
